get.summary: Conflicts awaiting a decision (default) or with another status; optionally for one vote (CON-01, CON-06).
Approved vs. proposed value with the source of each (CON-02).

post.summary:
Accept or reject (CON-04). 409 if another analyst already decided or the approved value changed meanwhile;
the problem body's `current` holds the conflict's current state (CON-05).

Uploads an Assembly export. Returns 202 immediately with the import's status and a Location header
to poll; validation and staging run in the background (ING-01).

get.summary: Current state and progress of an import (ING-02); survives page refreshes.
Persisted import report (ING-14/15): totals per classification, conflicts, what happened to each vote.

Row-level results with row number, reason and original value. Without classification:
the rows that were not stored as-is (duplicates, invalid, contradictions, conflicts).

post.summary: Queues a snapshot (SNP-01/02). 400 lists selected votes without a position (POS-04).

get.summary: Ranking with the scoring rules used (SNP-03); never changes once completed (SNP-04).
Contribution of every vote to one state's score.

post.summary: Admin marks the snapshot as the published one for a quarter (SNP-05). 409 if the quarter is already published.

get.summary: Pre-defined users for the "switch user" menu. Anonymous: it is needed before a user is chosen.
The user identified by the X-User-Id header.

put.summary: Admin only (POS-01). 400 with field errors (e.g. weight 7), 409 if changed concurrently.

XUser.description: Pre-defined user id: dana, omar (Analyst) or lena (Admin).
